boundary: Exact-type internal positional results and writable independent value copies. Offline checked data ownership only; no frame/group/kinematics, native layout/ABI or controller-runtime claim.

rules.documented: Chapter 5 permits data-type function results except FILE, PATH and Vision types. The JOINTPOS, POSITION, XYZWPR and XYZWPREXT entries explicitly list function return values. CONFIG is included through that general rule and its predefined type definition; its entry does not separately repeat a function-return purpose.
rules.implemented: Internal functions may return CONFIG, XYZWPR, XYZWPREXT, POSITION and JOINTPOS1..9. Unsuffixed JOINTPOS has nine axes. Every RETURN checks the exact declared type, all initialized leaves, numeric values, CONFIG bounds and joint width, then copies before frame cleanup. No partial result is exposed.
rules.restriction: No cross-type/width coercion, aliases, external FROM, frame/group metadata, kinematic conversion or controller ABI. POSITION orientation has no source initialization path or invented default. ARRAY results outside array_routine_semantics.json and direct STRING results remain blocked.
rules.tests: tests/test_positional_routines.py: each type/width, recursion, local/global/formal/field/element results, fallthrough, cleanup and malformed values

rules.documented: Expressions, including grouped variables, pass temporary value copies. Bare variables retain references. CONFIG scalar subfields are always passed by value.
rules.implemented: Grouped exact-type storage and positional function results create independent writable temporaries. Bare forwarding keeps the owned temporary; regrouping copies again. Captured field references survive whole-temporary replacement. Bare positional records and joints retain reference passing. CONFIG scalar subfields keep their special value-only rule.
rules.restriction: Fully initialized values only. All argument-order, potential-write/delay/output/ABORT, indexed-target, FOR and call-depth guards remain conservative. Whole ARRAY values remain blocked. Bare protected POSITION orientation arguments remain blocked.
rules.tests: tests/test_positional_routines.py: reference/value isolation, forwarding, selected elements/fields, single evaluation, effect/order guards and ABORT

rules.feature: POSITION protection and context-free joint copies
rules.implemented: The shared checked aggregate-copy layer preserves recursively read-only POSITION NORMAL/ORIENT/APPROACH and writable LOCATION/CONFIG_DATA. JOINTPOS copies retain declared axis count without requiring or inferring active conversion context. Existing CNV_REL_JPOS/CNV_JPOS_REL still require explicit matching Program(joint_axes=n).
rules.restriction: Complete POSITION tests use a clearly synthetic host fixture only. Data construction does not establish a valid robot configuration, frame, orientation, joint limits or units. Existing array/joint conversions remain degree-only offline models; copy support adds no millimeter/group mapping.
rules.tests: tests/test_positional_routines.py: protected synthetic fixture, CONFIG ranges, exact widths 1..9, context independence and retained conversion guards

unresolved: Native positional value/return layout, runtime copies and partial/uninitialized behavior
POSITION source initialization/acquisition and native read-only passing contract
Frame/group metadata, axis units/limits, cross-width/type conversion and kinematics
Broader ARRAY results and whole ARRAY values, STRING result conflict and writable STRING temporary capacity
Controller register/file access, external binding and motion

array_routine_update.boundary: Internal unsized anonymous outer ARRAY results with supported scalar, explicitly bounded STRING, record, exact-width joint or prior named fixed ARRAY elements, one outer dimension and at most three logical dimensions. Independent recursively checked copies and direct assignment only; all scalar leaves known/initialized. Exact STRING element capacities retained and checked without result truncation. Named outer results, flat multidimensional result sources/declarations, unspecified STRING capacities, direct STRING returns and whole ARRAY value arguments remain blocked.
